heading_en: Market Risk Equivalent Amount Based on Non-Modellable Risk Factors
summary_ja: モデル化不可能なリスク・ファクターについて、ストレス・シナリオを用いてマーケット・リスク相当額（SES）を算出する方法と、ストレス・シナリオの要件、流動性ホライズン等を定める。
summary_en: Sets how the market risk equivalent amount (SES) for non-modellable risk factors is calculated using stress scenarios, the requirements for the stress scenarios, and the liquidity horizons.
paragraphs: For non-modellable risk factors in trading desks, an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall calculate the market risk equivalent amount using stress scenarios. In this case, the market risk equivalent amount shall be the sum of the market risk equivalent amounts calculated based on each non-modellable risk factor.

The sum of the market risk equivalent amounts in the preceding paragraph shall be calculated using the following formula. {{F:p343i2}} SES is the sum of the market risk equivalent amounts based on non-modellable risk factors; i is a non-modellable risk factor relating to credit spreads; j is a non-modellable risk factor relating to idiosyncratic equity risk; k is a non-modellable risk factor in a trading desk using the internal model approach (excluding those falling under i or j); ISES_{NM,i} is the market risk equivalent amount for credit spread risk factor i; ISES_{NM,j} is the market risk equivalent amount for idiosyncratic equity risk factor j; SES_{NM,k} is the market risk equivalent amount for non-modellable risk factor k; ρ is 0.6.

The stress scenarios in paragraph (1) shall satisfy all of the following requirements. (i) The loss is calculated on the basis of a 97.5 percent confidence level; (ii) The stress period uses a common 12-month period for all non-modellable risk factors in the same risk class; (iii) A document stating the appropriateness of the common 12-month period under the preceding item shall be prepared; provided, however, that where that appropriateness cannot be explained, a stress scenario that takes into account the maximum possible loss shall be used.

The liquidity horizon n used in calculating the market risk equivalent amount based on non-modellable risk factors in paragraph (2) shall be the period set out in the lower column of the table in Article 254-2, paragraph (3), according to the risk class set out in the upper column and the risk factor category set out in the middle column of that table (20 days where that period is less than 20 days).

Where the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency judges that it is appropriate to appropriately reflect a decline in market liquidity, the Commissioner may require the liquidity horizon n in the preceding paragraph to be set to a longer period.

An Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach may set the correlation coefficient to zero in the aggregation of the idiosyncratic credit spread risk and the idiosyncratic equity risk in the formula of paragraph (2). In this case, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal model approach shall prepare a document showing the appropriateness thereof and shall maintain arrangements so that it can submit that document upon request of the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency.
